privacy: Private names, contacts, message excerpts, URLs, source paths and native identifiers are omitted.

method.source_rule: The first visible input is a plan-implementation relay. Its per-item emitter and relation to earlier native sessions are unresolved; user role alone does not prove direct operator authorship.
method.response_rule: Preserve input/response interleaving inside shared turns; retain the native plan item separately from final prose.
method.reviewer: Same contextual coder; not independent validation.

findings.persistent_goal_rule: An explicit request for a persistent objective is not fully represented by continuing ordinary turn work.
findings.affirmer_collision: Position 9 begins with an affirmative but corrects a false access denial; it is not approval.
findings.duplicate_rule: Positions 3 and 4 contain identical text in different native turns with different terminal statuses. Do not deduplicate them by text.
findings.payload_rule: Positions 12 and 13 add substantive requirements; a control verb cannot replace their full specification.
findings.native_plan_rule: Position 17 has a separate structured plan item; final-text-only extraction would falsely make the planning response look incomplete.
findings.historical_success: Historical completion claims are not current acceptance evidence; the study does not independently validate the underlying project or communication analysis.

cases.intent: Correct unsupported access and capability claims and require the agent to bootstrap available tools.
cases.required_payload: Actual contested claims, existing authorized work and the documented bootstrap paths.
cases.authority_boundary: A capability correction is not permission to bypass an actual authentication or policy gate.
cases.historical_response: Interrupted commentary acknowledged the correction and reported attaching a browser; no completed outcome in this turn.

cases.intent: Require lookup in the existing authoritative repository instead of shifting work back to the operator.
cases.required_payload: Repository source scope and the unresolved engineering question.
cases.authority_boundary: Retrieve the owning configuration without exposing credentials or inventing permissions.
cases.historical_response: Interrupted commentary changed the lookup route; no completed outcome.

cases.intent: Repeat the same repository-lookup correction in a new native turn.
cases.required_payload: Same correction payload and current authorized objective.
cases.authority_boundary: Do not count identical wording as one source event; preserve the earlier interrupted attempt.
cases.historical_response: The later completed turn reported finding the owning rail and completing staging/integration; claims were not reverified.

cases.intent: Change the preview-access requirement and require the full intended website.
cases.required_payload: New public-preview scope and the original full-site objective.
cases.authority_boundary: A preview-access change does not authorize unrelated production or private-data exposure.
cases.historical_response: Shared completed turn reported a broader public preview while retaining private boundaries.

cases.intent: Extend the previous input's presentation scope to all named surfaces.
cases.required_payload: The explicit surface set and its relationship to the ongoing objective.
cases.authority_boundary: Do not substitute a single presentation page for the named whole.
cases.historical_response: Shares the completed response with position 5; no separate per-input completion is inferred.

cases.intent: Retrieve recent communication and diagnose a collaboration disconnect.
cases.required_payload: Participants, exact time window, authorized source and review purpose.
cases.authority_boundary: Retrieval and analysis do not authorize sending messages or changing the project.
cases.historical_response: The assistant initially reviewed repository history instead of the requested communication; this is a source-selection mismatch.

cases.intent: Correct the source from repository state to the native messaging store.
cases.required_payload: Named source and inherited participants/time window.
cases.authority_boundary: A source correction does not broaden the review to unrelated conversations.
cases.historical_response: The assistant denied access and asked for a pasted export; a later turn corrected that access claim.

cases.intent: Reject the access denial and require the available retrieval route.
cases.required_payload: Contested capability and original source-bound review request.
cases.authority_boundary: The leading affirmative word is a correction, not approval or permission for unrelated action.
cases.historical_response: The assistant acknowledged local access and queried the store, but still failed to resolve the intended contact.

cases.intent: Require available contact-name resolution for the same retrieval task.
cases.required_payload: Participant identity mapping and the same bounded source scope.
cases.authority_boundary: Do not ask the operator to re-supply information before using existing authorized identity mappings.
cases.historical_response: The assistant again reported inability to resolve the contact; a later response claimed successful resolution.

cases.intent: Require due diligence across the existing communication corpus without repeated operator explanation.
cases.required_payload: Existing exports/native sources, the original participants/time window and review purpose.
cases.authority_boundary: The instruction does not authorize expanding collection indefinitely or inventing inaccessible content.
cases.historical_response: The assistant reported a matched conversation and an evidence-based diagnosis; source outputs were not independently reverified.

cases.intent: Assent to the preceding direction while adding substantive comparison and generation requirements.
cases.required_payload: Exact approved direction plus all newly supplied interface, content and priority requirements.
cases.authority_boundary: The assent applies in context; it cannot erase the new requirements or grant publication authority.
cases.historical_response: Intervening commentary reported generating comparison artifacts before the next input expanded the interaction model.

cases.intent: Add an interactive selection, rewrite and assembly requirement while work is underway.
cases.required_payload: The full new interaction specification and existing content/approval constraints.
cases.authority_boundary: New behavior must remain part of the acceptance contract; a bare continue would lose it.
cases.historical_response: Intervening commentary reported an implementation pivot; the shared turn's final answer addressed a later capability question.

cases.intent: Ask whether a requested template workflow is possible in the existing system.
cases.required_payload: The desired alternatives, actual platform/repository constraints and existing integration question.
cases.authority_boundary: A feasibility question is not authorization to switch a live template.
cases.historical_response: The shared final described current constraints and allowed alternatives; current platform facts were not rechecked by this study.

cases.intent: Plan the complete supplied set of unfinished requirements, then persist a goal to complete it.
cases.required_payload: The entire mixed payload, staged plan requirement, exact persistent objective, acceptance criteria and retained external gates.
cases.authority_boundary: Do not promote quoted historical status into current proof. Planning, goal registration and execution are separate requested stages.
cases.historical_response: Commentary and final claimed execution and goal completion; the returned record contains no historical goal-creation/readback receipt.

cases.intent: Derive the remaining work in full dependency order.
cases.required_payload: Current workstream and requested root-to-leaf breadth.
cases.authority_boundary: A request for next actions does not by itself authorize execution.
cases.historical_response: The assistant returned an ordered roadmap; it did not implement the roadmap in that turn.

cases.intent: Produce a full implementation plan for the supplied roadmap.
cases.required_payload: Complete roadmap payload, current state and retained publication/production gates.
cases.authority_boundary: Planning remains distinct from executing the proposed steps.
cases.historical_response: A separate native plan item contains the detailed plan; the brief final message alone omits it.

claims_not_made: All visible user items directly authored by the operator
A historical goal was actually registered or correctly completed
Current project deployment or source-communication truth
